ofn:Title: Bio-Intensive Market Gardening - Increased Biodiversity
ofn:Description: We increase diversity on our farm through growing a wide variety of organic seasonal fruits and vegetables, constantly rotating our beds. We have trees and perennials planted around the food-growing areas to form a windbreak and provide food and shelter for pollinators. This  incorporates biodiversity and supportive planting techniques to create a diverse and integrative system.
